scope: Initial source audit followed by authorized bounded repairs and lightweight local tests; no native release approval.

findings.summary: Sparse null verification uses the null-child window after restoring the original side.
findings.required_repair: Use beta-1,beta for the real-position verification, or disable sparse null pruning. Test a verification branch with positive and negative beta and confirm board restoration.

findings.summary: Initial disabled-fallback-deadline claim was incorrect: _root_search already enables it per child. Outer assignment is now explicitly True for clarity; actual fallback260ms regression passes.
findings.required_repair: No confirmed deadline defect; preserve passing real fallback/undo regression.

findings.summary: storm_rules600_control includes almost all Odin rules/search changes, beyond the required minimal cap/buffer repair.
findings.required_repair: Do not describe a match against this directory as full Odin versus minimally rules-corrected Storm. Construct an explicit minimal control from exact Storm archive or revise the experiment claim honestly before declaring holdout.
findings.status: new minimal storm_rules600_release_control built from exact Storm; old control preserved

findings.summary: Full order-sensitive game history keys score and move-ordering TT entries; history never resets after irreversible moves. Pair flag triggers all-legal prospective claim scans forever after any pair.
findings.required_repair: Measure representative long-history native roots. If material slowdown, separate safe position-only ordering hints from contextual scores and retain only a rigorously bounded reversible history. Do not relax score-context validity casually.

findings.summary: Unreachable fitted feature helpers reference undefined FILE_M, FEAT_MG and FEAT_EG; eval_nb.USE_FITTED_EVAL is True despite both actual evaluators remaining vanilla PeSTO.
findings.required_repair: Keep experiment disabled; remove dead native helpers and misleading flag from release candidate or document clearly. Do not accidentally compile them in a gate.

positive_observations: Legal exchange trial bitboards account for king safety and absolute pins; special promotion and EP occupancy updates are explicit.
Real game history capacity is dynamic with MAX_PLY slack.
Current FEN absolute ply is separate from search depth and cap decreases only on real legal edges.
Current score TT includes halfmove/cap/history context; normal legal-path score reuse is conservative.
Warmup and runtime packing use the same uint64 history signature and int64 two-slot deadline array.
Actual native and fallback evaluate functions both return vanilla PeSTO; positional fit is not active.

updates.summary: False rule50 claims below99 when called dueoldhistorypair; both native/fallback guards repaired.
Cap terminal precedence moved beforeMAX_PLY with rare local native scratch arrays.
updates.tests: Validmate/draw atply96, functionbody indexsafety and fallback terminalchecks.

null_history_fixture.conclusion: Passing to opposite side reproduces a twice-seen real board key, so a null subtree must not claim repetition against the pre-null real history. No losing selected move is asserted.
